command_targets.basis: EVF eye sensor, a TAOS/AMS proximity sensor as on the X-E2S (register prefix 0xA0 = command + auto-increment, ID register 0x12 = 0x39). X100T 1.11 configures it through 0x95FE18/0x95FE84/0x95FEE8 (register table 0xAFF1C4) when the display path changes; its output is GPIO 12.1, polled by the eyesensor task. Replies are the X-E2S declaration, not measured.

extra_registers.basis: Bus1 chip 10, after the lens bridge (114) and the PWIC (48), as on the X70. X100T 1.11 addresses it in mode 9, e.g. entering playback, which stops without it. Registers and masks are the X70's declaration of the same chip, not measured on an X100T.

capture_color.basis: X70 X-Trans II capture colour (same sensor), X100T 23 mm projection; reference white and saturation fitted on a grey scene under the X100T firmware white balance, not measured.

nd_filter.basis: Built-in 3 EV ND filter, a two-coil actuator on the lens unit output register 0xD400 (idle 0x054; insert coil bit 7 = 0xD4D4, remove coil bit 8 = 0xD554). X100T 1.11 parks it out at power-on and, with ND FILTER ON, swings it in for the exposure only; live view previews the ND digitally. Observed in the emulator; the 3 EV factor is the camera specification.
